يتراءوا (form VI)
# يَتَرَاءَوْا (yatarāʔaw) /ja.ta.raː.ʔaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاءَى (tarāʔā)
# يُتَرَاءَوْا (yutarāʔaw) /ju.ta.raː.ʔaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَرَاءَى (tarāʔā)
